summary: Quantum eMotion Corp., a Montreal-based quantum-safe cybersecurity developer listed on TSXV, NYSE American and Frankfurt, filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 27, 2026 press release announcing the appointment of David Wayne Teeple as Chief Technology Officer. Teeple, a board member since 2021 and founder/former CEO of Phirelight Security Solutions (acquired by RHEA Group in 2018), brings over 30 years of cybersecurity experience. This is a routine, planned executive appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure, so it does not qualify as a management-change special situation. The release also references a proposed acquisition of Plurilock Security Inc. as context only.
